purpose: Port the established Galileo broadcast clock-reference group-delay selection to the raw-only native GNSS measurement model without changing production defaults.

selection_basis.upstream_rule: external/madocalib/src/pntpos.c:155-158: F/NAV selects BGD E1/E5a (field 0), I/NAV selects BGD E1/E5b (field 1)
selection_basis.native_gap: src/algorithms/fgo_internal.hpp:241-246 currently returns eph.tgd for all Galileo signals; src/algorithms/spp.cpp:158-179 has the same behavior
selection_basis.raw_evidence: The declared development RINEX contains source codes 258 (F/NAV) and 513/516/517 (I/NAV); the retained two BGD fields differ on the I/NAV records.

raw_only_contract.coordinate_source: in-memory native raw GNSS/nav FGO only

candidate_contract.scope: Galileo E1 only; no Galileo E5a inference is added

source_selection.i_nav: when bit 9 is set and bit 8 is clear, use eph.tgd_secondary (BGD E1/E5b)
source_selection.f_nav: when bit 8 is set and bit 9 is clear, use eph.tgd (BGD E1/E5a)
source_selection.ambiguous_or_missing_source: preserve eph.tgd and increment a diagnostic fallback count; never guess

fail_closed: unknown source bits when strict candidate preflight is requested
candidate_contract.shared_contract: SPP seed and FGO pseudorange correction must call the same raw group-delay helper so candidate factors do not mix correction semantics

requirements: candidate source-specific counters nonzero or an explicit zero observation explanation
structural_gate_before_truth.artifact_policy: seal input/source/binary/config hashes and both control/candidate truth-free summaries before any ground-truth read

post_freeze_evaluation.scope: already-used development evidence only; not validation/holdout/generalization
post_freeze_evaluation.truth_policy: after structural artifacts are sealed, one evaluator process may read the declared development ground_truth.csv once and compare frozen control/candidate outputs
gate: all four local diagnostic variants strictly improve
post_freeze_evaluation.native_0_782_class_target: must remain explicitly unclaimed unless independently achieved

source_hashes_at_freeze.audit: compute after committing the paired audit record

implementation_rule: Commit this record before changing source. Implement only the shared source-specific E1 group-delay helper, explicit opt-in config/CLI wiring, diagnostics, and synthetic parity tests; do not change candidate scope or parameters after truth access.
freeze_record_sha256: excluded-from-self-hash; compute from the committed file
